problems.what: the title plate is fully built at frame 61 and starts wiping out at 74: 'TABLE TWO OPEN' holds under half a second and 'THE FINAL' (32 px) is legible for about 13 frames, well short of the package's own read-it-twice rule
problems.fix: hold the title to frame 105 (3.5 s), over the live picture, clear of the bug

problems.what: the lower third sits on MARSH's paddle (the action) for the whole four-second hold
problems.fix: cut to LUND's end under LUND's lower third, and MARSH's end framed so the paddle ends ~50 px above the plate

problems.what: the winning ball flies on into the 320 px band below the ticker and shows there, under the graphics
problems.fix: clip the vertical picture at the ticker's top edge

problems.what: the stats number column leans with the 12-degree spine, so the last row's '3' lands at about x=67, inside the 80 px safe margin
problems.fix: tighten the vertical number column (col 385 -> 350) and bar length (330 -> 300)

problems.what: the stinger's event mark (a deep plate) is still wiping out when the win plate's deep base wipes in over it: two deep plates cross in a messy diagonal for about 8 frames
problems.fix: clear the mark sooner (out 580-585) and start the win plate at 584

problems.what: the stinger's fifth (deep) bar is nearly invisible on the navy ground, so the open reads as four bars
problems.fix: a flat line-coloured sliver on the deep bar's leading edge (the brief's colour list is kept)
